The case: Liu2 purchased disabled persons' personal info (25,751 records) and phone, bank cards etc. Then used info to call people, pretended to be civil affairs bureau staff, defrauded victims of 302,840 yuan transferred to accounts. So crimes: fraud (诈骗) and illegal acquisition of personal information (非法获取公民个人信息) which is a crime under Chinese law: "非法获取公民个人信息罪" (illegal acquisition of personal information). So answer should be two crimes: 诈骗;非法获取公民个人信息. Format: [罪名]诈骗;非法获取公民个人信息<eoa>

Check examples: For "非法获取国家秘密" they gave answer "非法获取国家秘密". For "非法获取公民个人信息" not shown but similar. So final answer.
